value.rationale: The primary 2026 paper identifies reversal-symmetric serial-dictatorship mixtures as a natural fair implementation strategy and proves it can fail at n=4; the explicit positive n<=3 frontier was not in its proof. Constructive 4-priority repair for precisely 72 profiles, full exact classification, and efficient deterministic assignments give a substantive implementation theorem beyond merely proving arbitrary Dec-EF decomposability.
